name: @mercatus-liber/bundles
description: Multi-product bundles sold as a single purchasable tier selection on a PDP (subsystem 17). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- never imports @mercatus-liber/cart, @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders, @mercatus-liber/promotions, @mercatus-liber/inventory, or @mercatus-liber/catalog. Declares its own narrow SkuPriceLookup structural interface (satisfied by catalog's CatalogService at the app-composition layer) to validate skuIds and compute a tier's live sum-of-parts price, recomputed on every read and never cached into the Bundle record.
